check_if_token_is_cpp_keyword: use IsKeyword to check if a string token is a C++ keyword
check_if_token_is_builtin_type: use IsBuiltinType to check if a string token is a C++ builtin type
list_all_cpp_keywords: access the ALL set to get all C++ keywords defined in the module
list_cpp_type_keywords: access the TYPES set to get C++ type keywords like int, char, double
list_cpp_control_keywords: access the CONTROL set to get C++ control flow keywords like if, else, return
